gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_1
gatekeeper_rules.title: Tier-1 / SEC Source & Tradable Regular-Session Window
gatekeeper_rules.description: Leak must originate from WSJ, Bloomberg, Reuters, FT, or SEC 13D/8-K and offer a tradable regular-session entry before the definitive Merger 8-K is signed.
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Untradable Sunday/overnight gaps that open at the 8-K price ($KRTX, $ITCI, $BPMC, $VRNA) or vague 'weighing options' rumors with no named buyer ($APLS, $BBIO, $JANX).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_2
gatekeeper_rules.title: Commercial Launch or Pivotal Data + Standalone Cash Floor ('Walk-Away Leverage')
gatekeeper_rules.description: Per RA Capital Semper Maior 2026: Target must possess an FDA-approved commercial asset or de-risked pivotal dataset PLUS non-dilutive cash runway so the board can credibly say NO to a lowball bid (e.g., $RYTM's Nov 2 $750M KKR/Blackstone facility + $92.1M Q3 Imcivree).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Binary unapproved Phase 2/3 trial risk or financing overhang ($CYTK -16.69%, $MLTX -11.64%, $BBIO -12.24%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_3
gatekeeper_rules.title: Clean Cap Table & Unencumbered Global Commercial Rights
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target must own unencumbered worldwide rights (or have bought down royalty/partner encumbrances, like $RYTM buying down LG Chem's bivamelagon royalty to 1%).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Entangled regional/partner co-development rights that block rival bidders ($PTGX / J&J-Takeda -5.27%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_4
gatekeeper_rules.title: Multi-Bidder Scarcity / Contested Auction Trajectory
gatekeeper_rules.description: Target board has rejected an opening bid or attracted multiple Big Pharma suitors into the data room ($HZNP, $SGEN, $SAGE, $RNA, $MTSR, $CDTX, $RYTM AZN + 2nd bidder).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Uncontested solo-bidder drift where buyer lowers price over multi-week diligence ($SWTX Feb 2025 $54 -> $47 = -12.96%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_5
gatekeeper_rules.title: Hard Valuation Anchor Ceiling: entry_pct_of_anchor <= 0.92 (<= 92.0% of Floor)
gatekeeper_rules.description: Entry price MUST NOT exceed 92.0% of the leaked valuation anchor (entry_pct_of_anchor <= 0.92). For $RYTM ($124.00 floor), 0.92 * $124.00 = $114.08 hard ceiling ($112.50 open = 90.7% -> PASS).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Chasing above 92% of the rumored anchor ($VTYX $17.02 chase into $14.00 buyout = -17.74%; $MRTX $60.20 close into $58.00 upfront cash = -3.65%; $SWTX $54.00 spike = -12.96%).

gatekeeper_rules.name: BIO_GATE_6
gatekeeper_rules.title: 50% IRA Clip ($190k), 10–45 Day Hold Clock & 10% / 12.5% / 15% Limit Ladder
gatekeeper_rules.description: Reset expected hold clock from 1.5 days to 10–45 days (8–82d historical auction range). Deploy $190k (50% clip) in 0%-tax IRA via 3 limit tranches ($112.73 / $110.22 / $107.83 on $RYTM).
gatekeeper_rules.hard_fail: Oversizing > $200k or treating a multi-week contested auction like a 48-hour PE leak.
